cause: The low-power static SVG fallback had a fixed rem width and invisible 52px text. Its higher-specificity rule overrode the normal stamp sizing.
fix: Constrain the static image to its container and give its invisible text zero font size; add full stamp-box and explicit low-power audits for every certificate variant.

verification.result: The complete static DIBS graphic and Registered label fit inside the certificate at 320x568, text scale 1.3 and 200% zoom.
